name: Segment T2starw image using MNI152
summary: Segments a T2*-weighted magnitude image by registering the MNI152 2009b T2 template to it with ANTs SyN and warping the CerebrA atlas labels into subject space.
description: Downloads the MNI ICBM152 T2 template and CerebrA segmentation from OSF, registers the template to the T2*w image with ANTs and applies the warp to the CerebrA labels with nearest-neighbour interpolation, writing a parcellation with label.json. The intense parameter sets the registration effort; the default 'test' runs only a minimal registration, so set it to true or false for real use.

outputs.description: CerebrA atlas labels warped into T2*w space (parc.nii.gz with label.json).

parameters.description: Path of the template image registered to the T2*w image.
Path of the atlas segmentation warped into T2*w space.
Registration effort: true (more iterations), false (fewer) or test (minimal, for testing).

citations.text: Avants BB, Tustison N, Song G. Advanced normalization tools (ANTS). Insight J 2(365):1-35 (2009).

failure_modes.message: [ERROR] You must choose a value for intense: true, false, test
failure_modes.fix: Set intense to true, false or test.
